parameters.name: instanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance to which the topic to be created belongs.

parameters.name: topicName
parameters.description:
The name of the topic to be created, used for identifying the topic, and it must be globally unique.

Value specifications are as follows:

- Character restrictions: Supports letters a\~z or A\~Z, numbers 0~9, and underscores (_), hyphens (-).
- Length restrictions: 1 to 60 characters.

For reserved character restrictions, please refer to [Parameter Restrictions](~~440347~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rocketmq create-topic --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --topic-name topic_test --message-type NORMAL --remark This_is_the_remark_for_test. --max-send-tps 1500 --lite-topic-expiration 60 --region cn-hangzhou
